6c2853dc515e094c.description: تعمل منصة Material Stations في قطاع مواد البناء والتشييد بالمملكة العربية السعودية، وتربط الموردين ومحلات مواد البناء بالعملاء، وتتوفر عبر تطبيقات الأندرويد والآيفون. نبحث عن شخص مقيم في السعودية للعمل عن بعد (دوام مؤقت) في المبيعات الهاتفية واستقطاب الموردين. المهام: - الاتصال الهاتفي بموردي ومحلات مواد البناء (اتصال صوتي فقط، بدون رسائل واتساب). - التعريف بالمنصة وشرح الفائدة التجارية للمورد. - مساعدة المورد على إكمال بيانات شركته وإضافة المنتجات والأسعار حتى يصبح جاهزًا لاستقبال الطلبات. - تسجيل نتائج المكالمات والمتابعات في ملف Excel جاهز، وتقديم تقرير يومي مختصر. المطلوب: - الإقامة في السعودية، وإجادة اللهجة السعودية. - مهارات ممتازة في التواصل والإقناع. - خبرة سابقة في المبيعات الهاتفية أو خدمة العملاء، ويفضل سوق مواد البناء. - وسيلة اتصال محلية خاصة بك. - الالتزام بسرية أرقام العملاء وبياناتهم. - توفر وثيقة العمل الحر أو سجل مناسب لنوع التعاقد. نظام العمل: - تجربة أولى على 500 رقم من أصل حوالي 5800 رقم مستهدف، مع اسم الشركة لكل رقم. تُسلَّم الأرقام على دفعات صغيرة. - بعد قياس النتائج (عدد من تم التواصل معهم وعدد من أكمل التسجيل فعليًا) نقرر الاستمرار أو التوقف. - الأجر حسب العرض المقدم، مع حوافز مرتبطة بعدد الموردين الذين يكملون التسجيل فعليًا. للتقديم: أرسل نبذة عن خبرتك وأي نتائج حققتها في المبيعات الهاتفية، وسعرك لـ 500 رقم، وعدد الأرقام التي تقدر تتصل بها يوميًا.

6c5445ef0e4e29e4.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على الإشراف الهندسي وإدارة المشاريع الإنشائية، بدءًا من دراسة الموقع وحتى متابعة التنفيذ وإعداد التقارير الفنية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المهندس المدني في هذا الدور مجموعة من المهام الأساسية التي تضمن سير المشاريع الإنشائية بكفاءة واحترافية، وتشمل: دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع بدقة. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع ومطابقة المواصفات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في مجال الهندسة المدنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة لشغل هذا المنصب، يجب أن يمتلك المرشح المؤهلات والخبرات التالية: درجة البكالوريوس في الهندسة المدنية أو ما يعادلها. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية وإدارة المشاريع الإنشائية. معرفة قوية بأسس التصميم الإنشائي وتحليل التربة. القدرة على قراءة وتدقيق المخططات الهندسية وجداول الكميات. مهارات إشرافية ممتازة لضمان جودة التنفيذ ومطابقة المواصفات. المهارات والكفاءات يتطلب الدور مهارات تحليلية قوية والقدرة على حل المشكلات، بالإضافة إلى: مهارات تواصل فعالة كتابيًا وشفويًا. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق المتخصصة. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة في العمل. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتحمل ضغط العمل. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المهندس المدني ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة اسياف التطوير للمقاولات، مع التركيز على المشاريع الإنشائية في المنطقة. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال مراحل المقابلة.

6cb9bef68a9970c7.description: About the Role United Group is seeking a Process Engineer to join their team in Yanbu Al Sinaiyah, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position involves supporting the development, optimization, and troubleshooting of plant processes to ensure safe, efficient, and reliable production. The role focuses on monitoring process performance, investigating operational issues, and providing technical support to plant operators and engineering teams. Role Overview The Process Engineer is responsible for driving improvements in production, efficiency, reliability, and quality. This involves a range of activities from process design and optimization to performance monitoring, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis. The successful candidate will collaborate with various teams to resolve operational issues and support continuous improvement initiatives within the plant. Key Accountabilities Develop, review, and optimize process operating procedures, process designs, and engineering calculations. Identify opportunities to enhance production, efficiency, reliability, and product quality. Support the implementation of process improvements and engineering changes across the plant. Monitor plant and process performance against targets, identifying deviations and areas for improvement. Troubleshoot process deviations, equipment performance issues, and operational problems. Support shutdown, startup, and commissioning activities as required. Conduct root-cause analysis of process and equipment issues. Recommend and implement practical corrective and preventive actions. Maintain records of incidents, corrective actions, and lessons learned to support continuous improvement. Technical Support and Collaboration Provide technical support and guidance to plant operators and engineering teams. Collaborate with Maintenance, Quality, and Production teams to resolve operational issues. Support training of plant personnel on process procedures and best practices. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in process engineering. The role requires a strong understanding of plant processes, operational troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis methodologies. Location This position is based in Yanbu Al Sinaiyah, Al Madinah, Saudi Arabia, serving the Yanbu and Medina regions.

6cf8c6fda09d9956.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث ميد يان للخدمات الطبية عن أخصائي تسويق للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على التفاعل مع العملاء الحاليين والجدد عبر الهاتف للترويج لخدمات العيادة التجميلية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة ويعمل بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء المكالمات الهاتفية للرد على استفسارات العملاء وتقديم المعلومات اللازمة. تقديم العروض الترويجية والمعلومات المتعلقة بالعلاجات والعروض الخاصة للعملاء المحتملين والمراجعين الحاليين. حجز المواعيد ومتابعتها وتأكيدها مع العملاء. متابعة العملاء لضمان رضاهم وتحفيزهم للعودة أو تجربة خدمات جديدة. بناء علاقات قوية مع العملاء للحفاظ على ولائهم وتعزيز سمعة العيادة. جمع ملاحظات العملاء وتقديم تقارير دورية عن آرائهم واحتياجاتهم. تنسيق الحملات التسويقية عبر الهاتف والتفاعل الفعال مع العملاء. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التسويق أو خدمة العملاء، ويفضل أن تكون في التسويق الهاتفي. القدرة على التفاعل بفعالية مع العملاء عبر الهاتف. مهارات تواصل ممتازة ولباقة في التعامل. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات قوية في التواصل الشفهي والإقناع. القدرة على بناء علاقات إيجابية مع العملاء. مهارات تنظيمية لإدارة المواعيد والمتابعات. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتحقيق الأهداف المحددة. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي التسويق بدوام كامل في مقر الشركة بالرياض، ضمن فريق يدعم أهداف العيادة التجميلية في خدمة العملاء وتوسيع قاعدة العملاء. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق ميد يان للخدمات الطبية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

6c6545c39a9faec5.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Director - Utilities Operations - DCP and Gas Farms to lead the safe, reliable, and cost-effective delivery of district cooling and gas services. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh Province, and requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in utilities operations. Role Context Reporting to the Senior Director – Utilities, the Director will oversee managers, technical specialists, and service providers. This includes managing plant and network performance, system integrity, operational readiness, and lifecycle planning within established asset and service boundaries for district cooling and gas services. Key Responsibilities Translate utilities strategy into operating plans, maintenance programs, and measurable service standards. Direct the operation and maintenance of adopted district cooling plants, associated distribution assets, and customer interfaces. Hold specialist providers accountable for gas storage, handling, distribution operations, inspections, and maintenance. Oversee safety, compliance, and system-integrity assurance with authorized technical specialists. Assess cooling demand, gas supply requirements, capacity, and resilience, recommending improvements and lifecycle investments. Coordinate shutdowns, emergency arrangements, and service recovery with operators, customers, and response teams. Lead operational readiness and handover reviews, including commissioning evidence, asset information, defects, and warranties. Manage teams, service-provider performance, approved budgets, procurement inputs, and executive reporting. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Chemical, Energy, Process Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Typically 15+ years of relevant experience in district cooling, gas utilities, plant operations, engineering, or asset management. At least 5 years of leadership experience overseeing complex plants, networks, or service-provider portfolios. Leadership experience in district cooling or gas utility operations and maintenance, with exposure to both cooling and gas services. Experience managing specialist operators, contracts, operating budgets, capacity constraints, and lifecycle renewals. Experience transitioning plants and networks into live operation and coordinating outages, emergency arrangements, and operational recovery. Preferred Qualifications Relevant postgraduate qualification in utilities, engineering management, or asset management. Professional engineering registration or chartered status. Relevant certification in district cooling, gas operations, asset management, maintenance, or process safety. Application Process Candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply for this role at Qiddiya Investment Company.

6cadd17310b21d37.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة خالد عوض عويض الحمدى للأجهزة المنزلية عن بائع للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينة جدة، بمنطقة مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على بيع مجموعة متنوعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء، وتوفير معلومات دقيقة حول المنتجات، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عمليات الدفع والمخزون. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة من السلع والخدمات للعملاء بشكل فعال. توفير معلومات شاملة للعملاء تتعلق بالمنتجات، بما في ذلك استخداماتها وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام، والحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر ونظافته. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات عند الحاجة، والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة وتخزينها. تولي أمور الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء بدقة. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المتبعة في المؤسسة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات أو خدمة العملاء. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات تواصل جيدة ولباقة في التعامل. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، وتتطلب التواجد في المتجر للتعامل المباشر مع العملاء وإدارة عمليات البيع والمخزون. بيئة العمل ديناميكية وتتطلب القدرة على التكيف مع متطلبات العمل اليومية. طبيعة العمل الدور مخصص للعمل بدوام كامل، مما يتطلب الالتزام بساعات العمل المحددة لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة وفعالية. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. معلومات إضافية تعتبر هذه الفرصة مناسبة للأفراد الذين يبحثون عن بداية في مجال المبيعات أو تطوير خبراتهم الأولية في بيئة تجزئة نشطة. يتم تقدير المبادرة والقدرة على التعلم السريع.

6ceea05fa879325a.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إيه إم جى كير عن مساعد صحي للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم الدعم الأساسي للأطباء والممرضين في رعاية المرضى، سواء في المنازل أو المستشفيات، والمساهمة في توفير بيئة رعاية مريحة وفعالة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، وهو متاح بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحضير المرضى للفحص أو العلاج، وتجهيز الأدوات اللازمة للطبيب ومناولتها. تغيير أغطية السرير ومساعدة المرضى في النظافة الشخصية، بما في ذلك الاغتسال وارتداء وخلع الملابس، لضمان راحتهم. تقديم الوجبات الغذائية للمرضى في الأوقات المحددة ضمن البرنامج الزمني للرعاية. تسجيل العلامات الحيوية للمرضى وإعطاء الأدوية وفقًا للتعليمات المحددة. تنظيف وتطهير الأدوات والمعدات الطبية بعد الاستخدام، مع الالتزام بالتعليمات والإرشادات المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الرعاية الصحية أو دور مماثل. القدرة على أداء المهام الأساسية لمساعدة الأطباء والممرضين. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإرشادات المتعلقة برعاية المرضى والنظافة الطبية. بيئة العمل يعمل المساعد الصحي ضمن فريق رعاية صحية في شركة إيه إم جى كير، ويشمل نطاق العمل تقديم الرعاية في كل من المنازل والمستشفيات بمدينة جدة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. كيفية التقديم للراغبين في التقدم لهذه الوظيفة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم عبر قنوات التوظيف المتاحة.

6c8624a66a2b05af.description: About Rixos Hotels Rixos Hotels is a global hospitality leader, committed to supporting employee growth and learning. The company offers opportunities for individuals to find roles that align with their personality and aspirations. Rixos Murjana, a new property in King Abdullah Economic City, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, spans 275,000 square metres and provides an all-inclusive hospitality experience. The Opportunity: Assistant Manager Government Relations Rixos Hotels is seeking an Assistant Manager Government Relations to lead the government relations function for its property in King Abdullah Economic City, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing all employee and company government portals, ensuring compliance with Saudi laws and regulations, and representing the hotel before government authorities. The Assistant Manager Government Relations will report to the Director of People & Culture. Key Responsibilities Oversee all government transactions with entities such as the Ministry of Human Resources (MHRSD), Jawazat, GOSI, Qiwa, Muqeem, Absher, the Chamber of Commerce, and the Ministry of Tourism. Manage visa quotas and work visa applications, including iqama issuance and renewals, exit/re-entry visas, final exits, and transfers of sponsorship. Supervise employee contract registration and transfers on platforms like Qiwa, Mudad, and Ajeer. Ensure the validity of company licenses and documents, including the Commercial Registration, municipality licenses, Civil Defense permits, and tourism licenses. Monitor Nitaqat status, advise management on Saudization requirements, and support workforce planning to maintain hotel compliance. Develop and maintain a tracking system for employee and company document expiries, providing monthly reports to People & Culture and management. Handle labor office cases, inspections, and violations, representing the hotel at government entities as required. Stay informed on changes to labor, residency, and government regulations, assessing their potential impact on the hotel. Prepare and monitor the government fees budget in coordination with the Finance department. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess 5-10 years of relevant experience in government relations, preferably within the hospitality sector or a similar industry in Saudi Arabia. A strong understanding of Saudi labor laws, residency regulations, and government portal operations is essential. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in King Abdullah Economic City, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role requires on-site presence and interaction with various government authorities. Application Process The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process. Interested candidates are invited to submit their applications.

6c8cb2bd4e2edbf9.description: About the Document Controller Trainee Program Dar Al Riyadh is launching a Document Controller Trainee Program designed to develop Saudi national graduates. This full-time program offers structured training and practical experience in document control, project documentation, and electronic document management systems. The program is based in Riyadh and is open to candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Receive, register, classify, and distribute project documents. Maintain and update document registers and filing systems. Track incoming and outgoing correspondence. Monitor document revisions, approvals, and submission status. Ensure proper filing, archiving, and retrieval of documents. Coordinate with project teams and relevant departments regarding documentation. Training and Development Focus Areas Trainees will receive comprehensive training covering essential aspects of document control, including: Document Control Procedures. Project Documentation Management. Electronic Document Management Systems (EDMS). Document Numbering and Revision Control. Practical On-the-Job Training. Qualifications and Requirements Saudi national graduate. 0-1 years of professional experience. Ability to commit to a full-time training program in Riyadh. Career Development Upon successful completion of the program, trainees may be considered for Document Controller roles within Dar Al Riyadh. Progression is subject to individual performance evaluation and alignment with business requirements.

6cd3f2eaf6b187c0.description: About the Role Standard Chartered is seeking a Tanfeeth Ops Senior Officer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position for a Saudi National, requiring 0-1 years of experience. The role focuses on monitoring the automation B2B Tanfeeth Channel to ensure smooth processing and to report any technical challenges, as well as processing manual production orders. Key Responsibilities Monitor the automation B2B Tanfeeth Channel to ensure smooth processing and report any technical challenges. Process manual production orders received from central within approved Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Support and coordinate with technology teams to deliver new waves and requirements under the Tanfeeth project. Manage User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and Saudi Central Bank testing for new waves. Ensure timely reporting and communication to the Saudi Central Bank when required. Report risk items related to production orders Business As Usual (BAU). Meet regular requirements to manage production orders within agreed SLAs. Validate the execution of production orders. Ensure compliance with new Saudi Central Bank requirements for production orders. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate is motivated by delivering high-quality operational outcomes while ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and internal policies. This role suits individuals who are energized by identifying opportunities for process improvement, driving operational efficiency, and enhancing customer and stakeholder experiences. The candidate should thrive in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment that requires problem-solving, critical thinking, and effective decision-making. Collaboration with cross-functional teams to achieve shared business objectives and deliver sustainable business outcomes is also a key aspect of this role. Required Experience 0-1 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated resilience and adaptability in managing complex operational challenges, changing priorities, and continuous business transformation. Work Environment and Benefits Standard Chartered offers an inclusive and values-driven organization that embraces diversity across teams, business functions, and geographies. In line with its Fair Pay Charter, the company provides a competitive salary and benefits package designed to support mental, physical, financial, and social well-being. This includes core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations. Time-off benefits include annual leave, parental/maternity leave (20 weeks), sabbatical (up to 12 months), and volunteering leave (3 days), along with a minimum of 30 days for annual and public holidays combined. Flexible working options are available, based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns. The company also supports proactive well-being through platforms like Unmind, development courses for resilience and human skills, a global employee assistance program, sick leave, mental health first-aiders, and self-help toolkits. A continuous learning culture is fostered to support growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill, and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning resources.

6ce2b04c3ab46526.description: About Gramian Consulting Group Gramian Consulting Group is a boutique consultancy specializing in IT professional services and engineering talent solutions. The company focuses on building high-performing teams by matching professionals with specific client needs, drawing on a background in software engineering and leadership. About the Role: Mechanical Engineering & Computational Simulation Specialist Gramian Consulting Group is seeking a Mechanical Engineering & Computational Simulation Specialist to contribute to an AI training project. This full-time, output-based role focuses on engineering design, physical modeling, simulation, and technical problem-solving, requiring strong computational and programming skills. The position is coding-intensive and involves translating physical requirements into analytical or computational models. The work includes generating geometry and meshes, defining materials and boundary conditions, configuring simulations, and evaluating outputs against engineering and physical constraints. Key Responsibilities Solve and validate mechanical engineering problems across design, analysis, simulation, testing, and research and development. Translate physical systems and engineering requirements into analytical, numerical, or computational models. Create or modify engineering geometry, meshes, materials, loads, contacts, constraints, and solver inputs. Develop and execute Python-based workflows or utilize other programming languages for engineering calculations and simulations. Utilize AI coding agents to support engineering workflows, implementation, debugging, and technical problem-solving. Review computational solutions, simulation outputs, and generated engineering artifacts for correctness and consistency. Identify errors in modeling assumptions, physical constraints, numerical methods, code, and simulation results. Document methodologies, assumptions, validation steps, and technical findings clearly. Qualifications and Requirements Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related engineering discipline, or equivalent demonstrated knowledge of mechanical engineering fundamentals. Strong understanding of applied mechanics and core mechanical engineering principles. Experience developing analytical, computational, or simulation-based engineering solutions. Practical programming proficiency in Python or another programming language. Ability to independently write, understand, execute, debug, and validate code. Hands-on experience using AI coding agents as part of a technical or engineering workflow. Ability to translate engineering requirements into computational models and evaluate whether results meet relevant physical and design constraints. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and technical communication skills. Work Environment and Compensation This is a global, fully remote position, subject to platform eligibility. 6c8ad1afecb01138.description: About the Role TruKKer is seeking an Assistant Operations Manager for a full-time position in Dammam, Eastern Region. 6c9e789cca66138b.description: About the Role Ninja is seeking a Planning Specialist to manage the manpower capacity plan for dark store operations within the Planning & Fulfilment department. 6cf2d9eaff86d1a9.description: About the Role Norconsult Telematics is seeking a Senior Odoo Code and Performance Optimization Expert to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This contract role focuses on enhancing the performance, scalability, and reliability of the company’s Odoo platform. The expert will identify and resolve bottlenecks across application code, PostgreSQL databases, and supporting infrastructure to deliver measurable improvements in response times and concurrent-user capacity. Position Objective The primary objective of this role is to improve the Odoo platform's performance while maintaining functionality, security, and data integrity. The expert will also be responsible for strengthening the development team’s performance optimization practices through documentation and coaching. Key Responsibilities Establish performance baselines for priority user journeys and define measurable response-time targets with stakeholders. Profile Odoo, Python, PostgreSQL, and infrastructure components to diagnose latency, lock contention, excessive memory consumption, and repeated processing. Develop and maintain a prioritized optimization backlog based on business impact and technical findings. Refactor custom Odoo modules and Python code to optimize database queries, computations, and processing. Optimize PostgreSQL queries, indexes, execution plans, and transaction handling while ensuring correctness, security, and data integrity. Review and tune Linux/RHEL, Nginx, and Docker configurations to address resource constraints and bottlenecks. Conduct performance and load testing in preproduction environments to validate response times and peak-load concurrency. Deliver changes through peer-reviewed pull requests, automated regression testing, and controlled releases. Establish baselines, an optimization backlog, and initial fixes within the first 30 days; implement priority improvements within 60 days. Demonstrate sustained performance improvements within 90 days, supported by monitoring and documented practices. Document findings, implemented changes, and measured outcomes, and coach developers on performance optimization. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience. Minimum of 7 years in software engineering, including at least 5 years of hands-on Odoo development and a proven track record in optimizing production environments. Experience with recent Odoo versions; Odoo 18 experience is preferred. Advanced Python development skills, including debugging, algorithm optimization, and memory analysis. In-depth knowledge of the Odoo ORM, including inheritance, domains, computed/stored fields, dependency tracking, caching, scheduled jobs, access rights, and record rules. Advanced PostgreSQL skills, including SQL, execution-plan analysis (EXPLAIN ANALYZE with BUFFERS), indexing, query statistics, transactions, locking, deadlocks, and connection management. Strong understanding of PostgreSQL planner statistics and autovacuum, with the ability to trace database bottlenecks to application code. Hands-on experience with Odoo SQL and Periodic profiling, Python profiling (cProfile or equivalent), and memory profiling. Ability to interpret call stacks and flame graphs, correlating findings with PostgreSQL statistics (pg_stat_statements, pg_stat_activity, pg_locks) and ELK logs. Strong Linux/RHEL administration and Nginx configuration skills, including CPU, memory, and I/O diagnostics, reverse proxies, load balancing, TLS, and connection management. Hands-on Docker experience covering Dockerfiles, image builds, Compose, networking, volumes, health checks, logs, and resource limits, including troubleshooting CPU throttling and out-of-memory events. Experience with API integrations, Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and load-testing tools such as Locust, JMeter, or k6. Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills, with the ability to implement production fixes and transfer knowledge. Ability to present two production performance optimization case studies demonstrating the problem, personal contribution, and measurable before-and-after results. Work Type This is a contract position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring 5-10 years of relevant experience.

6c88cdf31dd10f02.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع الجريبي الطبي عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقه في جازان. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى توفير نقطة الاتصال الأولى للمراجعين والعملاء، وضمان تجربة استقبال سلسة ومنظمة. يتولى موظف الاستقبال مسؤولية إدارة الاستفسارات، وتوجيه الزوار، وتنظيم المواعيد، مع الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء بترحيب، وتحديد متطلباتهم، وتزويدهم بالمعلومات اللازمة. إعلام المرجع المعني بوصول المراجعين والعملاء وإرشادهم إليه. استقبال المكالمات الهاتفية والرد على الاستفسارات أو تحويلها إلى القسم المختص. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية للحصول على المعلومات المطلوبة. ترتيب وتنسيق مواعيد المقابلات. تسجيل أسماء المراجعين والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة لذلك. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات المنظمة والتقيد بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بمهنية ولباقة. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية وإدارة الوقت. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالتعليمات والإجراءات. التعامل الفعال مع المكالمات الهاتفية والاستفسارات. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مجمع الجريبي الطبي بمدينة جازان. سيعمل الموظف ضمن بيئة مهنية تلتزم بالمعايير والإجراءات التنظيمية لضمان تقديم أفضل خدمة للمراجعين والعملاء. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده ومناقشته خلال عملية المقابلة.

6cb27a2cf693b175.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة Bader International Shipping عن مساعد خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في مدينة جدة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تقديم دعم متميز للعملاء في مجال الشحن والتخليص الجمركي، ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنة وسنتين. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال استفسارات العملاء والرد عليها باحترافية عبر الهاتف، البريد الإلكتروني، والمحادثات المباشرة. تقديم معلومات دقيقة وشاملة حول منتجات وخدمات الشركة وسياساتها. معالجة طلبات العملاء ومتابعاتهم وشكواهم، والتنسيق مع الأقسام المعنية لضمان حلها بشكل كامل. توثيق بيانات العملاء والتفاعلات اليومية بدقة على نظام إدارة علاقات العملاء (CRM). إنجاز المهام اليومية والروتينية المطلوبة من المسؤول المباشر بكفاءة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة الجنسية السعودية. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنة إلى سنتين في مجال خدمة العملاء، ويفضل أن تكون في قطاع الشحن والتخليص الجمركي. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء بمهنية وحل المشكلات بفعالية. تفاصيل الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة جدة. يتراوح الراتب الشهري لهذه الوظيفة بين 3,750 ريال سعودي و 5,625 ريال سعودي. بيئة العمل ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة Bader International Shipping، وهي شركة رائدة في مجال الشحن والتخليص الجمركي، مما يوفر بيئة عمل ديناميكية وداعمة. التقديم للوظيفة ندعو الكفاءات السعودية المؤهلة للتقديم على هذه الفرصة للانضمام إلى فريقنا في جدة.

6cd55ca1c9c94570.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an App Security Expert based in Saudi Arabia. As an App Security Expert, you will help strengthen application security by designing realistic security test environments and evaluating vulnerabilities in traditional and AI-powered applications. You will focus on emerging security challenges associated with large language models (LLMs), including sensitive information disclosure and excessive agency. Through hands-on security engineering, you will develop deterministic test cases, create evaluation frameworks, and establish reliable methods for distinguishing vulnerable code from secure implementations. You will also contribute to advancing AI-powered static analysis and agent-based security architectures. Working in a remote, technically driven environment, you will collaborate with security specialists to refine testing methodologies and improve evaluation quality. This role is ideal for an experienced application security professional passionate about secure software development, AI security, and building practical solutions to complex cybersecurity challenges. Accountabilities Design and implement purpose-built application fixtures containing representative security vulnerabilities or secure implementations, with a focus on OWASP risks affecting large language model applications. Develop realistic test scenarios addressing critical LLM security concerns, including sensitive information disclosure, excessive agency, and related application security weaknesses. Create deterministic test cases and comprehensive security-context manifests to evaluate application security posture consistently and reliably. Develop detailed reference solutions and hidden answer keys that enable accurate evaluation of vulnerable versus secure code by AI systems and security scanners. Assess and refine testing pipelines, ensuring synthetic security tasks are realistic, technically challenging, reproducible, and suitable for application security evaluation. Build, inspect, and secure application codebases, identifying advanced vulnerabilities and implementing appropriate remediation strategies. Contribute to the design and evaluation of security architectures for traditional applications and agent-based systems. Apply knowledge of AI-powered static application security testing (AI-SAST) and LLM security to improve automated vulnerability detection and assessment methodologies. Document technical findings, testing approaches, security insights, and remediation recommendations in clear, precise, and actionable formats. Collaborate with distributed teams through effective written and verbal communication, providing constructive feedback and reviewing peers' technical contributions. Support the continuous improvement of security evaluation pipelines by identifying weaknesses, proposing enhancements, and validating new testing approaches. Requirements Extensive experience in application security, secure software development, cybersecurity engineering, or a related field, ideally with at least 5 years of relevant professional experience. Strong understanding of application security principles, secure coding practices, vulnerability assessment, and remediation techniques. Familiarity with OSWE-level application security concepts, advanced vulnerability research, and practical security testing methodologies. Solid knowledge of large language model security, including common LLM vulnerabilities, prompt-related attack vectors, sensitive information disclosure, and excessive agency. Experience with AI-powered static application security testing (AI-SAST), automated code analysis, or AI-assisted security evaluation. Proven ability to design, implement, secure, and test application codebases, including identifying complex vulnerabilities and validating secure implementations. Experience designing or evaluating security architectures for traditional software applications and agent-based systems. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to develop realistic security scenarios and distinguish meaningful vulnerabilities from superficial test cases. Familiarity with deterministic testing methodologies, synthetic security fixtures, or structured evaluation frameworks is highly desirable. Excellent technical writing skills, including the ability to document security findings, testing procedures, methodologies, and actionable recommendations with precision. Strong verbal communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to review peer contributions and communicate complex security concepts clearly. Ability to work independently, manage technical tasks effectively, and deliver high-quality contributions in a fully remote environment. A proactive mindset and a commitment to continuous improvement in application security, AI security, and emerging cybersecurity practices. 6cc3590b02b63bb8.description: Job Purpose: Operates in all clinic areas and in-patient areas to conduct echocardiogram (TTE and TEE), stress testing (treadmill, Dobutamine and thallium / Sestamibi with the nuclear imaging), and 24 hour holter (ECG) and BP monitoring procedures. Performs on patients of both sexes and all nationalities, thus ethical and cultural sensitivities are of paramount importance in the way the work is done. Coordinates with the cardiologists and specialists for supervision and reports. Key Responsibilities and Duties: 1. Echocardiograms Transthoracic Echocardiogram ( TTE ): Performs 2D echo Doppler studies on adult, pediatric and neonatal patients and writes down the preliminary results. Notifies cardiologists of suspected abnormalities necessitating immediate attention (e.g. Pericardial tamponade, cardiac tumors, malfunctioning valve prosthesis and complex congenital heart disease, etc.). Prepares reports / videos of patients for official reading of the Consultant Cardiologist. Maintains documentation and down-time equipment used in the Echo lab. Maintains statistics, patient record and area monthly report. Reports to supervisor / department head any staff problems / malfunction of the echo equipment. Requests and obtains outpatients charts on all scheduled patients. Maintains supplies as needed for the examination room. Maintains daily the examination room in a clean and orderly environment for patient care (including changing the bed sheets). Maintains daily census record of Echo procedures completed. 2. Trans-esophageal Echocardiogram ( TEE ) if applicable: Performs pre-procedure equipment preparation and sterilization and acquisition of signed consent form. Acquires quick history and physical examination about the nature of the disease. Helps the patient to understand what to expect, alleviate anxiety and enhance compliance during TEE examination. Also a brief drug and allergy history or dysphagia or esophageal disease should be elicited. line to administer sedation or emergency medications. Advises patient to remove dentures and places the mouth piece. Instructs the patient to lie on his left lateral position with neck and knee bent forward and swallowing during intubations with nasal breathing. Be alert in monitoring vital signs and complications. Monitor s the patient after the procedure at least 1-2 hours for potential complication of the procedures, anesthetic or sedative. Maintains census record of the procedure completed. 3. Stress Test: Treadmill Exercise Test, Dobutamine Stress Test, Exercise Sestamibi and Presenting Sestamibi. Prior to the test, explains the procedure to the patient: to dress comfortably ( e.g. loose fitting, light weight clothing and sports shoes not to eat a heavy meal 4-8 hours before the test Asks the patient to sign a consent form as per policy. Explains the procedure in detail and re-assure the patient if he/she is anxious. Garment/s above the waist should be removed temporarily in order to attach 10 disposable electrodes. Prepares the skin area where the electrodes are to be attached like shaving the area if necessary, rubbing the skin vigorously with alcohol swabs. Connects the lead wires to the patient s electrodes (lead wires are color coded). Position the cable yoke so that the cable does not interrupt the patient when he/she is on the treadmill. Records ECG preferably with the patient lying and standing. Takes the patient s blood pressure, preferably with the patient lying and standing. Sets the maximum heart rate to be reached for the patient in question. Ensures the crash cart is ready for use should an emergency arise. Maintains daily census record of the procedure completed. 4. Holter Monitoring: Explains the test to the patient. Asks the patient to remove clothing above the waist. Skin preparation: shaves hair if necessary, rub the electrodes sites several times with alcohol swabs. Attaches the electrodes for a two channel recording as shown in the operator s manual. Fix the electrodes with adhesive plaster. Attaches the cable lead wires following color coding as shown in the operator s manual. Makes stress loops to prevent from pulling the electrodes. After 24 hours, switch off the monitor and disconnect the patient cable lead wires from the electrodes. Take off and discard the electrodes. Process the unit in the computer by typing all the necessary information about the patient, scanning and saving the ECG tracings recorded for 24 hours then to be ready for analyzing of the specialist / consultant cardiologist. Maintains daily census record of the procedure completed. 5. Ambulatory Blood Pressure Monitoring: Explains the test to the patient and its indication. Sets the machine to check blood pressure every 15-30 minutes during the day and every 1-2 hours during sleeping time. After 24 hours, disconnect from the patient and scan it in the computer. Maintains daily census record of procedure completed. 6. Educates patients and their families about health conditions, treatments and preventative measures if applicable. Experience : Minimum of 3 years of practical experience Education : BS Medical Technology or any related medical field Language: English and Arabic preferred. Licenses / Certifications: License for practice as per the regional health regulatory authority e.g. (SCFHS / DHA), ACLS and BLS Desired Candidate Profile

Key Responsibilities Maintain optimal environmental conditions across greenhouses, conservatories, and specialised plant areas, including temperature, humidity, lighting, ventilation, and irrigation. Conduct regular plant-health inspections and identify signs of stress, pests, diseases, nutrient deficiencies, and environmental issues. Implement specialised care and maintenance protocols for rare, sensitive, and high-value plant collections. Operate, monitor, maintain, and troubleshoot irrigation, environmental control, lighting, sensors, and other horticultural systems. Manage irrigation and fertilisation programmes according to plant requirements, seasonal conditions, and water quality. Specialist certification or training in greenhouse management, controlled-environment horticulture, irrigation, plant health, or horticultural equipment maintenance is advantageous. Fluency in English and Arabic is required. Experience Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience in botanic garden maintenance, greenhouse operations, conservatories, specialist horticulture, or a comparable environment. Proven experience caring for rare, delicate, sensitive, or high-value plant collections. Hands-on experience with controlled-environment systems, irrigation, fertilisation, growing media, plant-health management, IPM, and greenhouse hygiene. Experience operating, troubleshooting, maintaining, and calibrating horticultural and environmental monitoring equipment. Experience implementing preventative and seasonal maintenance programmes and maintaining detailed technical and plant-health records. Previous experience in a botanic garden, conservatory, major public garden, research facility, or specialist horticulture environment is preferred. 6c70521fb180d39a.description: The Fire Safety Engineering Lead will act as a technical subject matter expert responsible for leading fire and life safety engineering activities at KAUST.
